posts.author: Spectrum Sports 360
posts.text: As soon as he was named the Orlando Magic's new coach, Sean Sweeney went to work to get to know the players and let them know what to expect from him and what he expected from them. They opened their NBA preseason schedule on Wednesday night against the Memphis Grizzlies.

posts.author: Orlando Magic Daily
posts.text: Sean Sweeney said Anthony Black suffered a "minor ankle sprain" during the voluntary workouts and has been held out of practice to start training camp as a precaution. He said Noah Penda also tweaked his hamstring. Team wants to be careful with two-a-day practices. #Magic
